input.body:
## Summary

A cached Sapper owner could create a replacement shot while its original projectile still existed in a detached field. The mount now retains the exact shot and captured master instead of searching the current wrapper's arrays. The original-frame probe and finding ledger are included with this larger second projectile layer; they explain why the provisional entropy adapter remains unchanged.

```text
Sapper mount
  keep exact projectile reference
  block replacement while initialized shot remains parented
  retain raw crossing-declined object
  retry after actual removal or rejected Setup
Sapper collision
  read captured master
  lazily cache its current life
  test physical owning-field containment
original frame probe
  preserve original ABC/nonbinding payloads
  observe original constructor/frame behavior
  retain entropy limits explicitly
```
